parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot, typically made of tempered glass with a metal or plastic handle on top.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, and can be lifted to check or stir the contents.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted off or placed onto the pot, but does not move independently when in place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot, made of stainless steel with handles on the sides.
parts.Functional_description: It holds food and liquids for cooking, providing even heat distribution and durability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, but can be lifted or moved by the handles.
